verdict.rationale: Apify supports scheduling actors/tasks at specific times, webhooks-style integrations via connectors (Notion, Slack, GitHub) that can 'trigger workflows mid-run', and API/CLI control, which enables some event-driven automation. However, there's no explicit evidence of a general rules engine for arbitrary event-triggered actions (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y' conditional logic) beyond scheduled runs and third-party integrations.
